answer: A refundable stake bond, hard to amass as a walnut tree's slow-grown kernel, gates entry and unlocks only as established peers attest honest work. A clone fleet must fund a fresh bond per fake and wait its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly instead of falling into a cheap canyon of free aliases. Correlated accounts emitting the same raven-like caw of coordinated behavior forfeit their collateral once the shared funding trail is exposed.
